# AGT-ACT-02

**Do irreversible, financial, destructive and external-communication actions need human approval, or sit behind a T0 or T1 limit?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI agent lens](ai-agent.md) 0.1.0 |
| Area | ACT: Actions and blast radius |
| Default severity | blocker |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `elements.agent.tools` |

## Rule

Every tool with reversible false, or effect financial, destructive or external-communication, has approval human-approved or forbidden, or tier T0 or T1.
